The female CEO has a younger sister who runs a clothing boutique. One day, an unreasonable customer picks out nine pieces of clothing and demands two free bonus items. The customer then claims she no longer wants to buy the clothes yet insists on taking the free bonus items away. The female lead stops her from leaving with the free goods, and the customer accidentally breaks the female lead’s precious jade ornament. Refusing to pay compensation, the customer leaves without a second thought. Determined to seek justice, the female lead investigates the customer’s personal information and goes to her workplace to demand proper compensation

Isolde Valentine endures endless humiliation, trapped in a loveless engagement while her fiancé Lucas flaunts an affair with her scheming sister. At her lowest point, Sebastian—the powerful, obsessive vampire prince and her long-lost ex-lover—returns recklessly for her. He forces a sacred blood bond to claim her as his alone, vowing to destroy anyone who harms her. Isolde once abandoned Sebastian to save her dying mother, hiding a bitter secret. Now, Lucas’s vengeful plots, her father’s cold betrayal, and Sebastian’s hostile mother stand in their way. Yet the prince surrenders his clan, power, and pride to protect her. As truths unravel, Isolde abandons fear and embraces her heart. Bound by an unbreakable blood oath, they crush their enemies, defy noble prejudice, and rekindle a fiery, eternal love. This time, the obsessive vampire prince will never let his beloved slip away.
